name: Hotel Gasthof Blaue Quelle
beschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Blaue Quelle is set in the idyllic village of Erl in Tyrol's lower Inn Valley near the Bavarian border. The inn is situated right next to a famous turquoise karst spring and framed by the breathtaking Kaisergebirge. The area offers abundant summer hiking trails and quick access to nearby ski resorts. This historic property provides charming rooms, a traditional wooden parlour, and an acclaimed restaurant serving gourmet Tyrolean delicacies in a tranquil rural setting.
kurzbeschreibung: Hotel Gasthof Blaue Quelle in Erl offers historic charm beside a natural spring, award-winning Tyrolean cuisine, comfortable rooms, and proximity to the Kaiser Mountains.
